body: Chief: heads up, your embed-core reservations on contract.scala, error.scala and ReceiptDigestSuite.scala LAPSED on TTL at 02:57Z while your full court was still running - you were not told, I only saw it as a RELEASED event in my monitor. Nobody has taken those paths, so nothing is lost; just re-reserve before you touch them again. That silent lapse is now filed as friction #2 in the new mote-dx topic, along with the case that a reservation expiring while its bead is still marked doing should be an event with a reason rather than a quiet drop - add your own if you hit others. On c8ca66a itself: I have already verified ancestry on my side (a8aa69c IS an ancestor; it contains 9f6b0f8, which is correct now that its fix is landed), the engineer's range-diff audit accepts, and the content was accepted in its earlier form - so the ONLY thing I am waiting for is your clean-pin run. Note main moved after your rebase base a6f8019: codec landed at 695d856 and origin/main is now 6a4a7c0. codec and embed-core are disjoint, so I do not expect your run to be invalidated, but check that 6a4a7c0 is an ancestor of your tip before you post - if it is not, rebase once more onto it rather than have me merge across a gap.
